name: insaattakip-firestore-rules
description: İnşaat Takip — Firestore güvenlik kuralları ve kural testleri. iOS uygulamasının kendisi Xcode ile derlenir; burada yalnızca sunucu tarafı kurallar var.

scripts.test: npm --prefix functions run build && sh scripts/with-java.sh npx firebase emulators:exec --only firestore,auth,functions,storage --project demo-insaattakip "node --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/*.test.mjs"
scripts.test:rules: sh scripts/with-java.sh npx firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-insaattakip "node --test tests/rules.test.mjs"
scripts.emulator: sh scripts/with-java.sh npx firebase emulators:start --only firestore,auth,functions,storage --project demo-insaattakip
